subject: Music Production
title: The Amen Break: Most Sampled Loop Ever
description: A quick, practical guide to The Amen Break: Most Sampled Loop Ever.

hook.text: A six-second drum solo from a 1969 B-side by The Winstons became the most sampled loop in history.

buildup.text: Hip-hop producers in the 1980s discovered this break and looped it under countless rap records.

discovery.text: The same break later became the foundation of jungle, drum and bass, and breakbeat genres entirely.

twist.text: The Winstons never received royalties for the Amen break despite its use in thousands of songs.

climax.text: Six seconds of drumming shaped more genres and songs than most artists create in a lifetime.

punchline.text: Six seconds of drums built entire music genres.

quiz.question: Which genre was NOT built on the Amen break?
